v_join_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.department = 'Women'

v_join_02.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Cancelled' AND p.category = 'Jeans'

v_join_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.country = 'China'

v_join_04.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

v_join_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.brand) FROM order_items oi JOIN users u ON u.id = oi.user_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE u.gender = 'F'

v_date_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2022-07-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-01'

v_date_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE created_at >= '2023-01-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-08'

v_date_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipped_at >= '2022-11-01' AND shipped_at < '2022-12-01'

v_date_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE created_at >= '2021-01-01' AND created_at < '2022-01-01'

v_date_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at < '2022-01-01'

v_biz_01.sql: SELECT AVG(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Complete'

v_biz_02.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Complete') / COUNT(*) FROM order_items

v_biz_03.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' AND p.category = 'Jeans'

v_biz_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'cart'

v_biz_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float / COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM events

v_empty_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE traffic_source = 'Pinterest'

v_empty_02.sql: SELECT id FROM order_items WHERE sale_price > 5000

v_empty_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE department = 'Kids'

v_empty_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at < '2015-01-01'

v_empty_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE browser = 'Opera'

v_agg_02.sql: SELECT traffic_source, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY traffic_source ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

v_agg_03.sql: SELECT AVG(age) FROM users WHERE gender = 'F'

v_agg_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM events WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) > 1) t

v_agg_05.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY 1

v_agg_06.sql: SELECT u.state, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.state ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

v_agg_07.sql: SELECT AVG(retail_price) FROM products WHERE department = 'Women'

v_agg_08.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

v_agg_09.sql: SELECT browser, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY browser ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

v_agg_10.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Returned'
